Clockwork parade-elephant's mainspring releasing its full stored tension simultaneously, the brass figure rearing onto its hind legs above the boulevard crowd, who surged backward in one laughing terrified tide

Aurora bleeding green and violet across the open-air balloon-launch festival, visible through the lifting silk envelopes, every face tilting skyward as the launch-master's countdown dissolved into wordless collective reverence

Standing ovation igniting in the gods gallery above and plunging downward through the dress-circle, the stalls, the pit, like water finding every level, hats cascading upward in a rising copper-and-felt storm

Rival dirigible-yacht nosing unbidden through the exhibition's glass-domed skylight aperture, its lacquered hull blotting the chandelier-light, uniformed crew leaning over the gondola-rail while the crowd below erupted in scandalized roaring

Chandelier catching the pyrotechnic upwash and beginning to revolve slowly on its chain above the ballroom floor, prism-drops scattering fractured gaslight across six hundred astonished upturned faces

Parade's lead automaton honor-guard suddenly abandoning march-tempo and locking into a slow ceremonial waltz, brass knees lifting with impossible precision while the boulevard crowd pressed forward three-deep in stunned hilarity

Final firework of the coronation gala erupting twice the diameter of any preceding burst, its copper-salt emerald flooding the Thames embankment as every gasping spectator reflexively gripped the arm nearest to them

A single heckler in the upper gallery unfurling a hand-painted banner across three rows, the message unreadable in gaslamp-glow from the stalls, the entire audience craning and squinting in rising agitated murmur

Trained falcons released from the royal-box at the champion's crossing, their jesses trailing copper ribbon, the birds wheeling above the grandstand while twelve thousand pairs of opera-glasses swung upward in unison

Stage-floor trap opening to admit a rising column of white steam that engulfed the conductor mid-downbeat, the orchestra holding its chord while the audience erupted in startled half-laughter and half-alarmed applause

Snow filtering through the exhibition-hall's cracked skylight dome at the automaton-revue's climax, dusting the brass performers' shoulders in white while the audience stretched gloved hands upward to catch it in disbelieving delight

Orchestra ceasing absolutely on one conductor's cut, the silence landing on the opera-house like a physical weight, every programme lowered, every opera-glass stilled, the gaslamps hissing into the impossible quiet

Wind seizing the diplomatic balloon's ceremonial pennant at launch and carrying it horizontally across the crowd, dignitaries snatching at their silk hats, the balloon surging free ten seconds early while the plaza roared
